lexicalDecisions.decision: Reuse existing 兼ねるかねる with N2 vocabulary level and its direct exclusions intact. Family1256520 sense1 is the kana-preferred difficulty suffix after masu stem; senses2/3 are combining functions/posts. Preserve sense-local kana flag, not a blanket claim that the ordinary role verb avoids kanji. かねない expresses possibility, not the simple positive can counterpart.

Only necessary new support is 兼任けんにん, selected concurrent-post sense. 兼務 and 掛け持ち are recognized related expressions, not additional articles needed for this card. 専任 contrasts dedicated service; 就任 is taking office, not the continued concurrent holding of posts.
The lexical conjunction means concurrent or dual functions/posts, not any two unrelated items joined by and. No separate word article is necessary to support this additional recognized use.

Retain beforehand/in-advance among raw meanings. A short scoped note may cite 兼題けんだい, topic announced in advance, without teaching it as a new practice word. Kana-preferred かねて/かねがね and archaicかねごと do not license invented reading metadata or modern commonness claims.

Retain spelling-local rare/search-only flags and the fossil family's katakana re_nokanji restriction. No search-only alias, proper organization name, fossil term or invented collocation is selected as practice. Missing priority flags alone are not rarity evidence.
